bundles.title: Bundles
bundles.description: Plans from several tools sold together at a discount on their summed price.
bundles.examplesNote: Example prices are monthly, for 5 users: the plans' summed price, then the price after the bundle's discount.
bundles.emptyBody: Create one to sell two or more plans together.
bundles.dialogHelp: The discount applies to the sum of the plans' prices in each country.
bundles.name: Name
bundles.nameHelp: English and Arabic are required; other languages fall back to English.
bundles.activeHelp: Off sale bundles stay with the customers who have them, but nobody new can buy them.

coupons.title: Coupons
coupons.description: Discount codes customers enter at checkout.
coupons.emptyBody: Create one to give a discount by code.
coupons.codeHelp: 4 to 20 capital letters or digits, unique.
coupons.dialogHelp: A percentage, or a fixed amount in each currency it can be used in.
coupons.redeemedSoFar: Used {count, plural, =0 {no times yet} one {# time} other {# times}} out of {max}.
coupons.amountsHelp: Add one amount for each currency the coupon can be used in.
coupons.onlyIn: This coupon works only for customers who pay in {currencies}. Customers paying in any other currency can't use it.
coupons.onlyInNone: Add at least one currency. The coupon works only in the currencies listed here.
coupons.noteHelp: For staff only; customers don't see it.
coupons.lockedBody: Customers have used this coupon {count, plural, one {# time} other {# times}}, so its discount stays as it is. To offer a different discount, end this coupon and create a new one.
coupons.refused: Customers have already used this coupon, so its discount can't change. End it and create a new one instead.
coupons.endImpact: Nobody can use it from now on. {count, plural, =0 {It hasn't been used yet.} one {The 1 customer who used it keeps the discount.} other {The # uses so far keep their discount.}}

errors.invalid: Use 4 to 20 capital letters or digits.
errors.taken: A coupon already has this code.
errors.required: Add an amount for each currency.
errors.after_start: Choose a date after the start date.

tax.title: Tax and gateways
tax.description: Tax rules per country, and the payment gateways each country and currency use.
tax.rulesHelp: One rule per country. Changes apply to invoices issued from now on.
tax.g12Title: Are prices shown with tax included?
tax.g12Body: This is still an open question. Until it's decided, no rule treats prices as tax-inclusive or tax-exclusive by default, and e-invoicing depends on OrgTik's legal entities.
tax.g12Where: It's decided once for the platform, in Settings.
tax.name: Tax name
tax.nameHelp: As printed on invoices, e.g. VAT.
tax.rateRange: Enter a rate from 0% up to 100%.
tax.priceDisplayOpen: Not decided yet (open question G-12). It's set for the whole platform in Settings.
tax.reverseChargeHelp: Business customers with a valid tax ID pay no tax; they account for it themselves.
tax.eInvoicingHelp: What invoices in this country need, for the finance team.
tax.activeHelp: When off, invoices in this country carry no tax.
tax.dialogHelp: The rule applies to invoices issued from now on; issued invoices keep their tax.

gateways.listHelp: Lower priority numbers are offered first.
gateways.recurringHelp: When off, customers renew by a payment link sent before the renewal date.
gateways.activeHelp: When off, customers are routed to the next gateway.
gateways.dialogHelp: Changes apply to the next checkout.
gateways.routeHelp: See which gateways a customer is offered, in order, for a country and a currency.
gateways.routeResult: {count, plural, one {# gateway} other {# gateways}} for {country} in {currency}:
gateways.routeListLabel: Gateways in the order they're offered
gateways.routeNoneBody: Customers there can't pay in this currency. Add the currency to a gateway or switch one on.
